CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  owner text NOT NULL,
  email text NOT NULL,
  tint text NOT NULL,
  agents integer NOT NULL,
  online integer NOT NULL,
  tasks integer NOT NULL,
  last_active text NOT NULL,
  created_week integer NOT NULL,
  mission text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plans (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL,
  monthly integer NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (
  account_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts (id),
  plan text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  mrr integer NOT NULL,
  ltv integer NOT NULL,
  started text NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS squads (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
  id text NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS masters (
  account_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts (id),
  name text NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agents (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
  id text NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  role text NOT NULL,
  tint text NOT NULL,
  is_on boolean NOT NULL,
  autonomy text NOT NULL,
  mission text NOT NULL,
  contribution integer NOT NULL,
  tasks integer NOT NULL,
  success text NOT NULL,
  saved text NOT NULL,
  last_text text NOT NULL,
  targets jsonb NOT NULL,
  kpis jsonb NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS machines (
  account_id text NOT NULL,
  agent_id text NOT NULL,
  host text NOT NULL,
  region text NOT NULL,
  size text NOT NULL,
  cpu text NOT NULL,
  uptime text NOT NULL,
  egress jsonb NOT NULL,
  secrets jsonb NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skills (
  account_id text NOT NULL,
  agent_id text NOT NULL,
  id text NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL,
  gate text NOT NULL,
  runs integer NOT NULL,
  is_on boolean NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, agent_id, id),
  FOREIGN KEY (account_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (account_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bus_events (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
  id text NOT NULL,
  time_text text NOT NULL,
  from_agent text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS state_entries (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
  key text NOT NULL,
  value text NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rules (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),

  agent text NOT NULL,
  action text NOT NULL,
  approval text NOT NULL,
  is_on boolean NOT NULL,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
  account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),

  agent text NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  detail text NOT NULL,
  amount text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mission_proposals (

  agent text NOT NULL,
  mission text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_revenue (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS overview_tiles (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threads (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_images (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bugs (
